package.description: Create movies quickly and easily with automatic recording functions, mouse tracking, and more.

en-US.description: Create movies quickly and easily with automatic recording functions, mouse tracking, and more.
en-US.longDescription: Gadwin ScreenRecorder allows you to create movies quickly and easily with automatic recording functions, mouse tracking, and more. This software allows you to capture cursor movements, menu selections, pop-up windows, layered windows, typing, sounds and everything else you see on your screen. Gadwin ScreenRecorder is versatile and extremely easy-to-use. Just click the record button to begin recording. Its as easy as that!
en-US.name: Gadwin ScreenRecorder

zh-CN.description: 通过自动录制功能、鼠标追踪等特性，快速轻松地创建影片。
zh-CN.longDescription: Gadwin 屏幕录像机让您通过自动录制功能、鼠标追踪等特性快速轻松地创建影片。该软件可捕捉光标移动、菜单选择、弹出窗口、分层窗口、键盘输入、声音及屏幕上的一切内容。Gadwin 屏幕录像机功能全面且极易上手，只需点击录制按钮即可开始记录，操作简单至极！
